name: Family Tree
author: Simitone
description: The Sims 2's family tree. In Create a Family, choose who is married and whose child is whose: they start out getting on as family, not as strangers. In a lot, see a Sim's tree, drawn as The Sims 2 draws it (Options > Family Tree, or F8). Babies are given their parents, and a proposal is a marriage. Not yet run in the game.
